title: Retro Viennetta
description: A layered frozen dessert of soured cream ice cream and chocolate-dipped wafers — a homemade tribute to the classic shop-bought Viennetta.

ingredients.text: 1 x 397g tin of sweetened condensed milk
250g chocolate-dipped wafers (e.g. Kit Kats or Tunnock's caramel wafers)

steps: Line a standard loaf tin with greaseproof paper, leaving enough overhang to cover the top.
Whisk the soured cream and condensed milk together until smooth.
Chop each wafer in half horizontally to make thin rectangles. Starting at the bottom, lay wafers in a neat layer covering the tin base. Pour in a layer of cream. Freeze for 1 hour.
Repeat with another layer of wafer and cream, and re-freeze. Continue until all ingredients are used, finishing with cream topped with finely chopped wafer.
Freeze for at least 6 hours or overnight.
Soften for 20 minutes before serving, then slice into chunky wedges with a serrated knife.
notes: Slices into at least 8 pieces. Per slice estimate.
